modelStudent.text: I see a girl with a watering can.

activities.title: Tell the Bean Story
activities.directions: Think about how Ana grew beans: plant, water, sprout, flowers. Tell the story with first, next, then and last.
activities.directionsEs: Piensa en cómo Ana cultivó frijoles: sembrar, regar, brotar, flores. Cuenta la historia con primero, después, luego y al final.

models.C: First, Ana planted the seeds in the dirt. Next, she watered them every day. Then little sprouts came up. Last, the plants grew flowers and beans.
